existingFixParts.note: Confirmed OEM 5VZ-FE second timing idler bearing. Distinct from 13503-62040; both are listed in the Aisin OE kit for 1995-2004 3.4L V6.

existingFixParts.note: Confirmed OEM thermostat housing gasket for the 5VZ-FE (Toyota lists thermostat 90916-03075 + gasket 16325-62010 together). Required to reseal the thermostat.

existingFixParts.note: Confirmed OEM front crankshaft (timing-cover) seal used on the 3.4L 5VZ-FE. Accessible only with the timing belt off, so it is a standard replace-while-in-there item to prevent a fresh belt getting oil-soaked.

existingFixParts.note: Confirmed genuine Toyota PN for 1996-2002 4Runner (3.4L 5VZ). Replace only if shaft seal/internal wear confirmed as leak/whine source after ruling out dirty fluid + clogged reservoir screen. OEM new ~$300-450; Cardone remans ~$120-200. Comes with reservoir. Refill with ATF (Dexron), never generic PS
existingFixParts.component: Power steering vane pump w/ reservoir — 3rd gen (1996-2002, 3.4L 5VZ-FE / 2.7L)

existingFixParts.note: Confirmed genuine Toyota PN for 2003-2009 4Runner (fits both 4.0 V6 and 4.7 V8). Do NOT use the 2010-2024 5th-gen pump 44310-60542 on this era. Aftermarket Cardone reman cross-refs listed are the commonly-cataloged fitment; verify by VIN before buying. Refill with ATF only.
existingFixParts.component: Power steering vane pump w/ reservoir — 4th gen (2003-2009, 4.0L 1GR-FE / 4.7L 2UZ-FE)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Toyota pressure feed hose for 1999-2002 4Runner. Early 1996-1997 3.4L uses 44410-35400 instead (different PN — match by year). This is the pump-to-rack high-pressure line; a common age-related leak point. OEM ~$120-150; aftermarket ~$40-90.
existingFixParts.component: Power steering pressure (high-pressure feed) hose — 3rd gen (1999-2002)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Toyota low-pressure return/reservoir hose for 2003-2009 4Runner — the frequently-cited lower return-hose leak. Low-pressure line, so many owners also use bulk 3/8 in PS return hose + clamps as a cheap fix. Confirm exact PN by VIN as return-line PNs vary by engine.
existingFixParts.component: Power steering return / reservoir hose — 4th gen (2003-2009)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Toyota banjo/union-bolt gasket for the PS pressure feed hose, cataloged 1994-2010 — this is the union-bolt sealing washer the fix calls out for pump-fitting leaks. Cheap; always replace both when the pressure line is disturbed. Buy 2.
existingFixParts.component: Pressure feed hose union-bolt (banjo) sealing gasket/washer

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Toyota pressure-port gasket for the feed hose; secondary sealing washer at the port side. Confirmed Toyota PN. Replace alongside 44327-30030 when resealing pump-fitting leaks.
existingFixParts.component: Pressure port gasket (pump/rack pressure port seal)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine Toyota PS reservoir for 2003-2009 4Runner (the tank whose bottom filter screen clogs). 3rd-gen 1998 4Runner uses 44360-20170 instead. Usually the screen is just cleaned with brake cleaner (free), but list this if the tank is cracked or the screen is non-serviceable. Match PN to year.
existingFixParts.component: Power steering reservoir tank (if screen clog / cracked tank)

existingFixParts.note: CRITICAL consumable: the 4Runner PS system uses ATF (Dexron II/III), NOT conventional power-steering fluid — wrong fluid swells seals and causes failure. Dexron VI is a backward-compatible replacement. ~1 qt for a flush/refill. No single OEM PN (any quality Dexron ATF qualifies), so OEM PN left empt

The 1ZZ-FE's original rings (13011-0D010) had poor oil drain-back; Toyota's revised low-tension oil-control ring set 13011-0D090 (production change ~06/2003, finalized 05/2005) is the anti-consumption design. Era-correct for 2000-2008 1ZZ-FE. Orde
existingFixParts.component: Revised piston/oil-control ring set (primary repair part)

existingFixParts.note: The late revised piston 13101-0D091 has additional/enlarged oil drain-back holes behind the oil-control ring — the actual TSB counter-measure for consumption. Pairs with rings 13011-0D090. Era-correct (fits 2000-2008 1ZZ-FE VVT-i). Earlier 13101-0D040 (2000-01) and 13101-0D090 are the pre-revision p
existingFixParts.component: Revised piston set (if pistons replaced, not just re-ringed)

existingFixParts.note: Fits 1999-2007 Corolla 1ZZ-FE / 2003-2008 Matrix. First-line cheap fix for minor cases per the documented diagnosis, and a mandatory replacement during any ring/piston job. 12204-22040 supersedes to -22041; -22050/-22051 is the interchangeable later casting.
existingFixParts.component: PCV valve (rules out/eliminates PCV as consumption source; required on rebuild)

existingFixParts.note: Complete 1ZZ-FE overhaul gasket set for Corolla — includes head gasket, valve-cover gasket, intake/exhaust and crank/cam seals needed to open the engine for the ring/piston repair. existingFixParts.component: Full engine overhaul gasket set (consumables to reassemble after ring/piston job)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine 1ZZ-FE cylinder head gasket; required whenever the head is removed to access pistons/rings. Confirmed fitment on 1ZZ-FE (Corolla/Matrix/RAV4). Multi-layer steel. Torque-to-yield head bolts should be replaced alongside.
existingFixParts.component: Cylinder head gasket (standalone, if not using full set)

existingFixParts.note: Genuine 1ZZ-FE Corolla valve/cylinder-head cover gasket. Verify year suffix at counter — 11213-0D010 covers the early run; a superseding suffix may apply to late 2007-2008 units. Included in the full gasket set above if that route is chosen.
existingFixParts.component: Valve cover gasket (consumable; also PCV-area seal)

existingFixParts.note: Toyota factory iridium plug (Denso SK16R11) for 1ZZ-FE, one-per-cylinder x4. Oil-fouled plugs are a documented symptom; replace after the ring repair. Era-correct for 2000-2008 1ZZ-FE. Gap ~0.043 in (1.1 mm), pre-gapped from factory.

Bank 2 twin = 89467-0E240 / Denso 234-9154. Earlier eras: 2004-2007 3.3L V6 = Denso 234-9054; 2001-2003 V6 = De
existingFixParts.component: Upstream air/fuel (A/F) ratio sensor, Bank 1 Sensor 1 (P0420 diagnosis)

existingFixParts.component: Downstream oxygen (O2) sensor, Bank 1 Sensor 2 (the sensor that sets P0420)

existingFixParts.component: Alternator assembly (Denso, with regulator)

existingFixParts.component: 12V battery, Group 35
